stories.title: Houthis launch heaviest attack in years on Saudi oil facilities, wounding 73
stories.reason: Dozens of ballistic missiles set Aramco facilities and an airbase ablaze after a four-year Saudi-Houthi truce collapsed in July, and Saudi Arabia has already retaliated -- opening a dangerous new front alongside the Iran war.

stories.title: UK bans goods from Israeli West Bank settlements, accuses settlers of 'ethnic cleansing'
stories.reason: Israel says it will close the British consulate in Jerusalem in response, while the US warns British companies could face restrictions -- and France and Canada are preparing similar bans.

stories.title: Witkoff reports 'substantive progress' on Ukraine peace talks as brief ceasefire ends
stories.reason: The temporary halt in fighting expired today and heavy Russian airstrikes have resumed, even as Zelenskyy says he hopes to meet Trump around September 20 to build on the groundwork laid in Moscow and Kyiv.

stories.title: Mistral raises €3 billion at a €21 billion valuation, Europe's largest-ever tech funding round
stories.reason: Led by Samsung with BlackRock and Luxembourg's government joining as new investors, the round underscores how 'sovereign AI' has become a serious commercial category as Europe seeks alternatives to US and Chinese labs.

stories.title: China unveils plan to quadruple AI computing capacity to 9,800 exaflops by 2030
stories.reason: The five-year plan commits 3.8 trillion yuan ($532 billion) in infrastructure spending and calls for 10,000-GPU compute clusters, a state-directed answer to Washington's chip restrictions.

stories.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect hours after Trump's Bombardier threat
stories.reason: PM Mark Carney's $27.6 billion in tariffs on US goods kicked in just after midnight, escalating a trade war Trump deepened by threatening to block Bombardier jet sales unless production moves to America.

stories.title: Stocks fall as Saudi attacks and trade tensions compound Middle East oil jitters
stories.reason: Apple, Alphabet and Microsoft led declines of more than 2% as investors weighed the widening Saudi-Houthi conflict, renewed US-Iran strikes and escalating US-Canada trade friction all at once.

stories.title: US sanctions all remaining Iranian airlines over oil-smuggling ties
stories.reason: Treasury Secretary Bessent warned that doing business with the sanctioned carriers risks being cut off from the global financial system, tightening the economic squeeze as Brent crude hits a seven-week high near $97.
